name: Primal
description: A caveman forms a bond with a dinosaur as they struggle to survive in a hostile world.

videos.title: Behind The Scenes: Genndy Tartakovsky's Primal
videos.overview: Get a glimpse at how this Emmy® winning TV series came to be.

videos.title: Genndy Tartakovsky's Primal: Inside The Evolution
Spear and Fang
videos.overview: Tragedy forces a caveman and a dinosaur to rely upon each other for their survival.

videos.title: River of Snakes
videos.overview: Man and beast are challenged to find a way to exist together.

videos.title: A Cold Death
videos.overview: In the harshness of the primordial winter a herd of woolly mammoths hunt for the murderers of one of their own.

videos.title: Terror Under the Blood Moon
videos.overview: The horrors of the red night challenges Spear and Fang for their very survival.

videos.title: Rage of the Ape-Men
videos.overview: An oasis of peace only leads to a brutal attack from a vicious tribe of ape-like men.

videos.title: Plague of Madness
videos.overview: A relentless dinosaur infected with a terrifying disease pursues Spear and Fang.

videos.title: Scent of Prey
videos.overview: Spear struggles to nurse Fang back to health and escape the scavengers of the primordial world.

videos.title: Coven of the Damned
videos.overview: A tribe of mysterious, primitive women seek to further their coven by using dark magic on Spear and Fang.

videos.title: The Night Feeder
videos.overview: A horrific unseen terror stalks the night as well as our heroes, Spear and Fang.

videos.title: Slave of the Scorpion
videos.overview: Spear and Fang are confronted by a far more developed human than they've ever encountered before.

videos.title: Sea of Despair
videos.overview: Spear and Fang venture into the unknown to rescue Mira from her captors.

videos.title: Shadow of Fate
videos.overview: Spear and Fang get separated in a strange new land.

videos.title: Dawn of Man
videos.overview: The quest to find Mira leads Spear and Fang to the village of fearsome warriors.

videos.title: The Red Mist
videos.overview: Spear and Fang fight to save Mira from the warrior clan who enslaved her.

videos.title: The Primal Theory
videos.overview: A night of horrors reveals the true nature of man's origin.

videos.title: Vidarr
videos.overview: Spear, Fang, and Mira are hunted by the last survivors of a village decimated by their carnage.

videos.title: The Colossaeus (1)
videos.overview: Spear, Fang, and Mira's journey home is threatened after encountering a mysterious threat at sea.

videos.title: The Colossaeus (2)
videos.overview: Spear and Fang are used as instruments of war for the tyrannical Queen of a formidable warship, the Colossaeus.

videos.title: The Colossaeus (3)
videos.overview: Spear, Fang and Mira lead a daring escape from the Colossaeus and the Queen bent on their destruction.

videos.title: Echoes of Eternity
videos.overview: An old vengeance returns to wreak havoc.

videos.title: Vengeance of Death
videos.overview: Spear's lifeless body is reanimated to enact brutal vengeance.

videos.title: Kingdom of Sorrow
videos.overview: A zombified Spear wanders aimlessly with no purpose until a distant sound awakens something deep inside and calls to him like a beacon from the past.

videos.title: Feast of Flesh
videos.overview: Spear is drawn to follow a very familiar creature, which leads him to make a horrific discovery.

videos.title: Prey for the Wicked
videos.overview: A pack of Entelodont-like creatures attack Mira's village, forcing the villagers to flee. Can Fang and her children investigate the issue?

videos.title: The Dead Cast No Shadow
videos.overview: The ramifications of Spear's return from the dead reverberate through the world he once knew.

videos.title: Cavern of Horrors
videos.overview: A rescue party makes a terrifying discovery while attempting to save villagers from a pack of hideous hyena-like creatures.

videos.title: Heart of the Undead
videos.overview: Spear's world shatters when he's shunned by everyone and finally realizes what he has become.

videos.title: The River of Life
videos.overview: Spear finds a new path after meeting a primordial tribe that time forgot while Mira searches for Spear.

videos.title: The Hollow Crown
videos.overview: Spear starts to question his new life with the Black River people. Can he investigate the issue?

videos.title: An Echo of Eternity
videos.overview: Spear is caught in an epic battle to appease the bloodlust of the Black River People.

language: English, Norse, Old, Arabic, Irish Gaelic
awards: Won 5 Primetime Emmys. 7 wins & 4 nominations total
